mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An inflationary spike in the CPIAUCSL index exceeding 3.0% triggers heightened risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods exceeding 3.0% CPIAUCSL are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the threshold is not consistently breached.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in labor participation (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) strengthens labor market confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises 1% and UNRATE falls 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: The labor market interaction does not hold consistently or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in economic demand (GDPC1) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline) lowers discount rates, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises 2% and FEDFUNDS falls 1% in a month
failure_condition: The interaction between GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS does not occur as predicted or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An expansion in supply capacity (INDPRO exceeding 105) reduces production bottlenecks, boosting future demand and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO exceeds 105 but 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or inflation offsets gains.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions marked by rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) create optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises 1% and UNRATE falls 0.2pp in a month
failure_condition: The labor market interaction does not occur as expected or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained high GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust demand, which enhances equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not rise sufficiently in the late-cycle expansion regime or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, simultaneous growth in economic demand (GDPC1) and rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) create conflicting signals, but persistent demand growth still drives positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 does not occur as predicted or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
